name: Education and Human Capital
summary: Research examines barriers to quality learning, learning poverty, and unequal access to educational resources, and how these gaps shape income and social mobility.
overview: The agenda evaluates scalable education policies and interventions using experimental and quasi-experimental methods alongside administrative and survey data.

projects.title: Scaling Digital Learning to Reduce Inequality: Evidence from a Randomized Trial in Mexico
projects.summary: A randomized trial evaluates the UNICEF and Microsoft Learning Passport in Mexican upper-secondary schools, with attention to learning outcomes and inequality.

projects.title: Human Capital in Mexico: Does Being Late Have a Cost? Starting Age, Schooling Delay, and Returns to Education
projects.summary: Studies whether school starting age and delayed progression through school affect later labor-market outcomes.
